title: pipelines → studio's projector: one graph step of a pipeline row (the execution view)
description: Subject evt.pipeline.<batch_id>.step (stream EVT), Nats-Msg-Id <batch_id>:<seq> (seq shared with evt.pipeline.batch and .row). Published for pipeline batches when a graph step finishes, parks (status current) and is resumed (resumed, same step number). Whole state of (row, attempt, step): the projector keeps the newest seq per key and ignores older ones. Studio stores them with the batch; the execution view (GET …/rows/{row}/execution) is built from them.

step.description: the graph step's number in this row attempt, from 1, in order

part.description: which graph node of it: inputs, a step's submit / wait, a gate's gate (parked) / route (pick applied, edge chosen), output; from API 1.14 a judge's submit / wait (its ask run), verdict (the answer checked, the decision derived), gate (Suggest: parked for a pick), route; a write's submit / wait / apply (the text set); a decide's submit / wait / route; a memory node's memory. A replayed decision: submit is followed by the next part at once (no wait)

visit.description: the node's visit in the row, from 1

status.description: finished; resumed after waiting; current = parked here now

changed.description: which part of the state changed (`takes.still = 4`)

edge.description: the edge taken out of the node (on its last part)

loops.description: gate, judge or decide id → capped turns so far (fail edge; a decide's routes other than then), after this step

checkpoint_id.description: LangGraph's checkpoint id after this step (the state request and retry-from-step name it); null while current

decision.description: from API 1.14: on the part that derived it (judge verdict, write apply, decide route), also when replayed or failed; absent elsewhere

memory.description: from API 1.14: the memory items this step read (from the batch's snapshot) and wrote (to the pipeline's live memory, seen from the next batch)
